description: Out-of-stock (OOS) encounters at picking time, and substitution offer outcomes, by category. An OOS encounter = picker reached the shelf and the item was not there. Simulates the live stock dashboard.

oos_rate_by_category.note: Weighed items; evening drain fastest. Matches picker field notes.
Never substituted, per the hard line in the substitution spec; OOS here always means item unavailable.

substitution_offer_outcomes.note: Lowest acceptance by far; supports the spec's hard line — most baby items are simply never offered a substitute.

note: 22% of substitution prompts get no customer answer inside the 3-minute window and fall back to the customer's saved default.
